chunks.head: hang about
chunks.note: 指在某处附近漫无目的地待着、徘徊。本章两个男孩守在客栈附近就是 hang about。

literal.note_cn: hang 此处非“悬挂”，指停留、徘徊

chunks.ex_en: The kids hung about the gate, waiting for the bus.
chunks.ex_cn: 孩子们在大门口闲待着，等公交车。

chunks.head: at a distance
chunks.note: 表示离得有一段距离地(观察、跟随等)。
chunks.ex_en: He followed them at a distance so they wouldn't notice.
chunks.ex_cn: 他隔着一段距离跟着他们，免得被发现。

chunks.head: slip out
chunks.note: 指不引人注意地悄悄出去。

literal.note_cn: 此处非“滑倒”，指不声不响地移动

chunks.ex_en: She slipped out of the room while everyone was talking.
chunks.ex_cn: 趁大家说话时，她悄悄溜出了房间。

chunks.head: feel one's way
chunks.note: 指看不清时用手摸索着慢慢走；也可引申为“谨慎试探地行事”。本章为前者。

literal.note_cn: 此处指用手触摸探路，非“感觉”

chunks.ex_en: The lights went out, so I felt my way to the door.
chunks.ex_cn: 灯灭了，我只好摸索着走到门口。

chunks.head: weigh upon
chunks.gloss: 压在心头；使(人)感到沉重
chunks.note: 指烦恼、焦虑等像重担一样压迫人的心情。

literal.note_cn: 此处非“称重”，指心理上的压迫

chunks.ex_en: The bad news weighed upon her all week.
chunks.ex_cn: 那个坏消息压在她心头整整一周。

chunks.head: take one's breath away
chunks.gloss: 使人喘不过气；(因惊吓/惊叹)使人透不过气
chunks.note: 本章指因恐惧而喘不上气；也常指美景等令人惊叹。
chunks.ex_en: The sudden cold wind took away my breath.
chunks.ex_cn: 突然刮来的冷风让我喘不过气。

chunks.head: for one's life
chunks.note: 常与 run 连用，表示像逃命一样拼尽全力。本章句中被逗号隔开，故只下划线 for your life。
chunks.ex_en: When the dog chased us, we ran for our lives.
chunks.ex_cn: 那只狗追来时，我们拼命地跑。

chunks.head: pour down
chunks.ex_en: We got soaked because the rain poured down all afternoon.
chunks.ex_cn: 整个下午大雨倾盆，我们都淋透了。

chunks.head: get one's breath
chunks.note: 指剧烈活动或惊吓后恢复正常呼吸。
chunks.ex_en: Give me a second to get my breath after those stairs.
chunks.ex_cn: 爬完那些楼梯，让我缓口气。

chunks.head: take hold of
chunks.ex_en: Take hold of the rope and don't let go.

chunks.head: shake off
chunks.note: 本章指抖掉盖在灯上的毛巾；也可引申为摆脱跟踪者、疾病等。
chunks.ex_en: The dog shook off the water after its bath.
chunks.ex_cn: 洗完澡，那只狗把身上的水抖掉了。

chunks.head: sound asleep
chunks.note: sound 此处意为“酣沉地”，形容睡得很死。

literal.note_cn: 此处非“声音”，指睡得深沉

chunks.ex_en: The baby was sound asleep before the story ended.
chunks.ex_cn: 故事还没讲完，宝宝就熟睡了。

chunks.head: spread out
chunks.note: 本章指手臂摊开;也可指人群散开、地图铺开等。
chunks.ex_en: He spread out his arms to catch the falling ball.
chunks.ex_cn: 他张开双臂去接落下的球。

chunks.head: look around
chunks.note: 指转头打量周围的环境。
chunks.ex_en: She stopped to look around the new classroom.
chunks.ex_cn: 她停下来打量了一下新教室。

chunks.head: what's the matter with
chunks.note: matter 此处意为“毛病、问题”；用于询问某人或某物出了什么状况。
chunks.ex_en: What's the matter with your phone? It won't turn on.
chunks.ex_cn: 你手机怎么了？开不了机。

chunks.head: act as if
chunks.note: as if 后接从句，表示某人的举止仿佛某种情况成立。
chunks.ex_en: He acts as if he owns the whole place.
chunks.ex_cn: 他表现得好像这地方全是他的。

chunks.head: something is up
chunks.note: be up 此处意为“出了不寻常的事”；常用于察觉到有异常。

literal.note_cn: 此处非“向上”，指出了状况

chunks.ex_en: The dog kept barking, so I knew something was up.
chunks.ex_cn: 那只狗一直叫，我就知道出情况了。

skipped: the Spaniard / Injun Joe / Hooper Street / Ben Rogers / Uncle Jake (专名)
Great Caesar's Ghost / Lordy / by hokey (一次性惊叹语)
in good season (古旧，可迁移性弱)
stood sentry (较文学化，控量舍去)
the blackness of darkness reigned (文学性一次性描写→难句层)
a power of racket / mighty sick / dead sure / quicker'n lightning (方言强调，迁移弱)
warn't / ha'nted / becuz / 'a' thought / less not / a body / tote (方言拼写表面形)
good as wheat (方言习语，一次性)
some time or other (备选，为控量舍去)
a couple of / all sorts of (偏基础/半语法化)
